_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: The test seeds a 12-turn conversation at /c/{{SLUG}} whose first two user messages have data-message-id {{FIRST}} and {{SECOND}}; the URL fragments that link to them are {{FIRST_FRAGMENT}} and {{SECOND_FRAGMENT}}. window.fragmentScrolls lists the data-message-id of every element scrolled into view so far, in order; check it with an eval of JSON.stringify(window.fragmentScrolls). Call "append" sends another message and waits for its reply; after it, {{APPENDED}} is the reply's data-message-id. To "set the fragment to X", eval a promise that sets location.hash to X and resolves on the next hashchange event. "At the bottom" means the messages container (".messages-container") has scrollHeight - clientHeight - scrollTop below 5 and the scroll-to-bottom button (".scroll-to-bottom-button") is hidden. To "delay" a message, rename its data-message-id attribute to data-delayed-message-id, as if its element had not mounted yet; to "mount" it, set data-message-id back from data-delayed-message-id (leaving the other attribute). Perform the steps in order. Changed fragments resolve and cancel the preceding retry. The page runs on a fake clock that steps advance with eval "window.__clock.runFor(ms)". Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}} and wait for the table of contents button (".toc-button") to be visible. Delay message {{FIRST}}. Set the fragment to {{FIRST_FRAGMENT}}, then run the clock for 100ms, then set the fragment to {{SECOND_FRAGMENT}}. window.fragmentScrolls should become ["{{SECOND}}"]. Mount the delayed message, then run the clock for 1100ms: window.fragmentScrolls must still be exactly ["{{SECOND}}"]. Set the fragment to {{FIRST_FRAGMENT}}: window.fragmentScrolls should become ["{{SECOND}}","{{FIRST}}"].

steps.expression: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('[data-message-id="{{FIRST}}"]'); if (el) { const id = el.getAttribute('data-message-id'); el.setAttribute('data-delayed-message-id', id); el.removeAttribute('data-message-id'); return 'delayed'; } return 'not found'; })()

(() => { const el = document.querySelector('[data-delayed-message-id="{{FIRST}}"]'); if (el) { const id = el.getAttribute('data-delayed-message-id'); el.setAttribute('data-message-id', id); return 'mounted'; } return 'not found'; })()
